target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
target_cwe.description: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.
remediation_steps: Use memory-safe programming practices and bounds checking
Implement proper resource management and cleanup

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: Image resampling with large externally controlled dimensions may lead to buffer overflows or operations beyond memory bounds, matching the mechanism of improper buffer restriction.
